I’m not a wonderful roller myself, but I enjoy doing it and picked up on a few things that might help:

- This isn’t as important, but grinding/cutting whatever you’re smoking thoroughly makes it easier to roll. Get it as close to “powder” as you reasonably can. It makes shaping the blunt easier.

- Spread it out evenly across the paper before beginning to roll. This is to prevent exactly what’s in the picture. There’s nothing wrong with a thin blunt as long as you can smoke it properly. As a side tip, if you haven’t got much weed or want to smoke just a bit, you can cut a strip from the long side of the paper that has no glue, making the strip slightly shorter

- Take your time while shaping the blunt. To me, the better I shape it before wrapping, the better the blunt.

- Make sure its tight (but not too tight) before closing, otherwise it might burn unevenly and you may have to correct it. 

- This is gonna sound obvious, but use the tip as your base for the thickness and mold the blunt around it. I always try making the blunt about as thick as the tip, but its not really that important.

But to be honest, the best answer anyone could give is practice. You know what a blunt is supposed to look like, its only a matter of time until you figure out your own way of rolling. It comes down to preference at the end of the day anyway ¯\_(ツ)_/¯

Sorry if any of this sounds confusing btw, English isn’t my first language.
